name: PinInputDiv
description: a series of single-digit inputs for entering a PIN or OTP code
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: Each input's `aria-label` comes from the optional `digitLabel(position, length)` (e.g. "Digit 1 of 4"); without it each input is named by `label` — no English default
keyboard: Digit entry: enters value and auto-focuses next input
Backspace: clears current or moves to previous input
Tab: standard tab navigation in/out of the group
props: `label`: string (required) -- accessible label for the group via aria-label
`digitLabel`: (position: number, length: number) => string (optional) -- each input's accessible name; defaults to `label`
`value`: string (default: "") -- bindable combined string of all digits
`...restProps`: Any additional HTML attributes on the group div
